note: Config-only submodule of Dashboards. It ships one View, dashboard_last_content ('Dashboard: Last content'), a node_field_data listing of recent content meant to be embedded on a dashboard via the base module's Embed a view widget (dashboards_block:dashboard:view_embed with view=dashboard_last_content:<display>). No PHP plugins/config entity/permissions/Drush. Medium cases read the shipped view (label/description set by setup). Hard cases: embed the view into a dashboard (verify the dashboard's view_embed component references dashboard_last_content); and re-enable the view after it is disabled (verify status). Verified by loading the View / dashboard config via drush.

evals.prompt: What does the dashboards_views submodule provide, and does it define any PHP plugins?
evals.expected_output: It is config-only (no PHP plugins). It ships the View 'dashboard_last_content' ('Dashboard: Last content'), a ready-made recent-content listing to embed on a dashboard.

evals.prompt: How do you show the dashboards_views 'last content' view on a dashboard? Which widget do you use?
evals.expected_output: Use the base Dashboards 'Embed a view' widget (block dashboards_block:dashboard:view_embed) and point its 'view' setting at dashboard_last_content:<display>.

evals.prompt: What is the dashboard_last_content view (shipped by dashboards_views) based on, i.e. what kind of content does it list?
evals.expected_output: It is a node_field_data-based view listing recent content (nodes); its default display is restricted to the 'administer nodes' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the view shipped by dashboards_views has been given a custom label. Inspect the live view configuration and report the current label (human-readable name) of the dashboard_last_content view.
evals.expected_output: The dashboard_last_content view's label is 'DV Probe Content List'. Read with `drush cget views.view.dashboard_last_content label`.

evals.prompt: Inspect the dashboard_last_content view (from dashboards_views) on this site and report the description that has been set on it.
evals.expected_output: The dashboard_last_content view's description is 'DV probe recent-nodes feed'. Discoverable via `drush cget views.view.dashboard_last_content description`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a dashboard with machine id 'dv_task' that embeds the dashboards_views recent-content view (dashboard_last_content) using the base Dashboards 'Embed a view' widget (block dashboards_block:dashboard:view_embed with its 'view' setting referencing dashboard_last_content). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard dv_task has a Layout Builder section component with id 'dashboards_block:dashboard:view_embed' whose configuration.view starts with 'dashboard_last_content'.

evals.prompt: The recent-content view that the dashboards_views module provides (dashboard_last_content) has been disabled, so its dashboard panel is empty. Re-enable that view and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The dashboard_last_content View is enabled (status TRUE), e.g. `drush php:eval 'Drupal\views\Entity\View::load("dashboard_last_content")->setStatus(TRUE)->save();'` or `drush cset views.view.dashboard_last_content status true`.
